name: Harribance 1997: four coil pairs x 0.5 s, sine, LTP and burst-firing blocks (Roll 2002)
origin: Persinger lab, Laurentian University: session with the psychic Sean Harribance first reported by Roll, Persinger, Webster, Tiller & Cook 2002; retold with the Koren Helmet and the 10% right-side bias in Persinger 2010
summary: The 1997 session with the psychic Sean Harribance (Roll et al. 2002): 3.3 Hz sine, an LTP pattern, 1.6 Hz sine and burst-firing, 2.5 min each after 3 min of no field, through four left-right solenoid pairs stepped every 0.5 s over the temporoparietal regions. The paper reports 22 button presses per minute during the LTP pattern, 7 to 12 during the other fields and 5 to 10 with no field (one subject, not blinded).
notes: Roll 2002: no pulse, 3.3 Hz sine, no pulse, LTP pulse, no pulse, 1.6 Hz sine, no pulse, burst-firing, run 'twice without interruption'; no-pulse intervals 3 min, field intervals 2.5 min, 4 s between envelopes (p.8-9 [203-204]). Two containers strapped over the temporoparietal regions (p.8 [203]) held four solenoids each, driven as left-right pairs for 0.5 s (Baker-Price & Persinger 2003 p.4 [968]). Persinger 2010 retells it with a helmet, 'counterbalanced order' and a right side 10% stronger (p.5-6 [448-449]). This program plays the sequence once (22 min). One left-right pair is on at a time, and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head. The four sites per side stand for the lab helmet's four solenoids per side on a 7.5 by 5 cm ellipse; the site names are this project's reading. The left coils run at 0.91, after the 2010 retelling. The LTP pattern is rebuilt from one sentence, 'a single pulse followed about 170 msec later by 4 pulses in rapid succession', at 100 to 200 Hz (Persinger 2010 p.6 [449]): 1-ms pulses at 0, 170, 180, 190 and 200 ms, then a 4-s gap. Pulse width, polarity and the 100-Hz spacing are this project's choice. Burst-firing is the project's rising sweep, 230 points of 3 ms, once every 4 s; its point values were never published. The sines play without gaps; the paper is silent on that. The paper gives 0.5 to 1.5 uT at the depth of the cortical surface (Roll 2002 p.8 [203]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT it is in the paper's range. One subject, not blinded, button presses only (p.16 [211]): an anecdote. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop on headache, nausea or distress.
setting: Seated and blindfolded in a quiet, dark room, holding a button or tally counter in each hand: press the left or right one when you sense a presence or see a vision on that side, both when it is in front of or behind you. Have someone else note which condition was running, or use the app's Blind option.
schedule: One session in the original (one subject, June 1997): this 22-min sequence twice without a break.
source: Persinger 2010, The Harribance effect as pervasive out-of-body experiences, NeuroQuantology 8(4):444-465, pp. 448-449 and 454 http://web.archive.org/web/20150426091303id_/http://www.neuroquantology.com/index.php/journal/article/download/301/346 ; Persinger & Murphy 2016, Neuroscience & Medicine 7:27-44 (Koren Helmet: four left-right solenoid pairs, 0.5 s each, 2-s cycle) https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/god-helmet/god_helmet_debate_publication.htm ; Roll, Persinger, Webster, Tiller & Cook 2002, Int J Neurosci 112:197-224 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12325407/ ; Persinger & Saroka 2012, Protracted parahippocampal activity associated with Sean Harribance, Int J Yoga 5:140-145 https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3410194/ ; Martin & Persinger 2004, Neurosci Lett 366:226-229 (burst-firing once every 4 s) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15276252/ ; Persinger, Hoang & Baker-Price 2009 (burst-firing about 0.7 s once every 3 s) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20017628/ ; Delparte & Persinger 2007, Int J Neurosci 117:295-299 (LTP field as "1 s pulse of 5 trains") https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17365115/ ; Corradini 2014, MA thesis, Laurentian University (primed-burst LTP file) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/1455e1f3-2f1d-47b5-93cd-23713d69e651 ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1-6 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
